scope: All 10 standalone installed non-system Codex packages and their identical Claude mirrors, individually reconciled; vendor/system/project-upstream packages inventoried separately. Existing 23 Mac/Meta packages preserved.

configuration_review: Codex config.toml skill/plugin/project path keys inspected without copying configuration or credentials; no extra skill root configured.
CODEX_HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, T3_HOME unset; standard homes used.
No ~/.agents, ~/.cursor, ~/.opencode or ~/.config/opencode directory on the operating account.
Custom plugin skill search includes project sources and installed plugin roots; discovered installed plugin skills belong to bundled/curated vendor packages.
discovery.symlink_handling: Inspected targets deliberately; skill aliases resolve to already enumerated .agents packages. Resolved packages deduplicated; byte-identical copies recorded as separate provenance sources. No symlink copied.
content_exclusions: browser profiles, screenshots and account evidence
raw logs, generated files, build outputs, Python caches
whole upstream archives and plugin caches (only package hashes/provenance inventoried)
coverage_limits: /root and /home/canvasadmin are not readable by t3worker. No privileged access to other users was available.
Several /opt deployment/private backup directories and system temporary directories are unreadable; these were not bypassed.
Excluded caches and raw session/browser data were not searched for recoverable skills. This inventory covers accessible configured roots and relevant sources, not every file on the VPS.
